findings.summary: "7d" preset was not fixed and still spans 8 days, not 7.
findings.mechanism: The comment and fix apply the correct daysAgo(n-1) adjustment to "30d" and "90d" (daysAgo(29), daysAgo(89)) but leaves "7d" at daysAgo(7) unchanged, so with the inclusive to-today window it still covers 8 calendar days — contradicting the stated task of making "Last 7 days" span exactly 7 days.
